basics.headline: BSCS Student at GU TECH | Aspiring Cybersecurity Professional | Focused on SOC Foundations, Network Security & Web Pentesting
basics.summary: Currently pursuing a BS in Computer Science while building a hands-on foundation in cybersecurity. I am a dedicated learner focused on defensive security operations, networking, and application security.

intro: I am an aspiring Cybersecurity professional with a deep curiosity for how systems function and how they can be secured. My approach is hands-on first — I learn best by spin-up labs, fire up Metasploit, analyze traffic, and document every step.
Currently building my foundation across SOC operations, network security, and web application pentesting while pursuing my BSCS at GU Tech / Al-Ghazali University.
